title: Customer Order
description: Schema for customer purchase orders used in email-to-ERP integration. Defines the structure for orders parsed from customer emails and submitted to the ERP system.

customerNo.description: Customer account number in the ERP system. Used to identify the customer placing the order.

poNumber.description: Customer's purchase order number. This is the reference number the customer uses to track the order on their end.

externalRefNo.description: External reference or tracking number. Optional field for additional customer-provided reference information.

contact.description: Contact information for the order. Identifies who placed the order and how to reach them.

id.description: Contact ID in the ERP system. Numeric identifier for the customer contact.

emailAddress.description: Email address of the contact who placed the order.

lines.description: Order line items. Each line represents a product being ordered with its quantity and configuration.

partNo.description: Product part number or SKU in the ERP system.

quantity.description: Number of units being ordered for this line item.

configuration.description: Product configuration options including decoration and customization details.

type.description: Configuration type indicating the nature of the order line.

proofRequested.description: Whether the customer has requested a proof before production.

allowShipEarly.description: Whether partial shipments are allowed before the full order is complete.

decorations.description: Total number of decoration locations on this item.

locations.description: Decoration location details. Each entry describes a specific decoration placement on the product.

locationId.description: Numeric ID for the decoration location from the ERP lookup table. Identifies where on the product the decoration is placed (e.g., front, back, sleeve).
locationId.$comment: Values come from ERP decoration location lookup table

method.description: Decoration method code indicating how the artwork is applied.

artNumber.description: Artwork reference number in the ERP system. Links to the specific artwork file to be used.

logoName.description: Human-readable name for the logo or artwork being applied.

numberOfColors.description: Number of colors in the decoration.

shipViaCode.description: Carrier or shipping method code. Identifies the shipping carrier and service level for the order.
shipViaCode.$comment: Values are carrier-specific codes configured in the ERP system.

shipToAddress.description: Shipping destination address where the order should be delivered.

address2.description: Secondary address line (suite, apartment, building, etc.).

address3.description: Additional address line for complex addresses.

state.description: State or province code. Use 2-character abbreviation.

zipCode.description: Postal or ZIP code. Supports US ZIP codes (5 or 9 digit) and Canadian postal codes.

countryCode.description: ISO country code for the shipping destination.

attachments.description: Supporting documents attached to the order, such as artwork files, purchase order copies, or proofs.

url.description: URL or file path to the attachment.

type.description: Category of the attachment indicating its purpose.

fileName.description: Original filename of the attachment for reference.
